basic_info.description: Perfectly located on the border of Bernal Heights, Noe Valley & The Mission, offering amazing access to wonderful local shopping & dining, this gorgeously renovated 2 bed/2 bath 1st floor condo will warm your heart, offering an ideal setting to call home. With classic early 18th century detail, hardwood floors & high ceilings, this wonderful flat includes a spacious living & dining combination that is open to a beautifully remodeled kitchen. Just down the hall is a recently remodeled bathroom, & an a 2nd remodeled bathroom near one of the 2 rear bedrooms overlooking the exclusive use deck & shared backyard. There is interior access to the garage off of the main hall. Garage includes side-by side parking for one car & abundant storage space. Primary bedroom has direct access to an exclusive use deck & a nicely landscaped yard. The yard is shared with the neighbor upstairs, creating an attractive, peaceful space for relaxing or hosting some friends for a sunny, Bernal backyard barbecue. The location could not be more convenient with Cortland Ave, Mission District & Noe Valley local shops & a multitude of amazing dining options moments away. Public transit is close by as is access to 280 for access to the Peninsula/SFO or 101 to downtown San Francisco & the East Bay. Welcome home!
